newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil hit by futures and some easier premium.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil hit by futures and some easier premium.

text.p: NWE gas oil was knocked lower by easier IPE futures and some grades also suffered from easier premiums, traders said on Friday.
April IPE gas oil last traded $2.50 lower at $170.75 a tonne having thinly traded around unchanged for most of the day.
Activity was slight and although some players said there was expectation of a pick up in business next week ahead of Easter, others said there were few signs of an increase.
"I think there will be some letting go of positions people have taken who anticipated a rise in business ahead of Easter," said one trader.
Heating oil barge premiums looked under pressure with the lower levels seen on Thursday being consolidated.
March Flushing was done at April IPE -$2.75 fob while March Rotterdam material went at April IPE -2 fob and a barge of Antwerp tank went at April IPE -$2.50.
A first half April barge went at screen flat.

DIN cargo premiums were easier with an early deal done at April IPE +$5 cif Germany first half April and a later deal concluded at April IPE +$4 cif. Diesel premiums were also softer and there was some consensus that levels would ease $1 or so next week towards the April IPE +$10 cif level.
